errors.ERR_UNCLOSED_PAREN: Unbalanced or unclosed parentheses in expression.
errors.ERR_INVALID_ARG: Invalid numerical argument for this operation.

lab.graphIntro: Plot up to three functions of x. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom and hover to read values.
lab.graphAngleHint: Trigonometric functions in the plotter use radians.
lab.complexIntro: Arithmetic with z = a + bi, polar form, De Moivre powers and n-th roots.
lab.matrixIntro: Matrices from 1×1 to 6×6. The first column of B is used as vector b in A·x = b.
lab.statsIntro: Descriptive statistics, quartiles, histogram and linear regression. Separate values with commas, spaces or semicolons.
lab.solverIntro: Finds a root of f(x) = 0 with the bisection, Newton-Raphson or secant method.
lab.calculusIntro: Numerical derivatives (5-point central differences) and definite integrals (adaptive Simpson).
lab.financeIntro: Compound interest with contributions, loans (Price and SAC amortization) and rate conversion.
lab.unitsIntro: 13 physical categories with instant conversion and a full table.
lab.ntIntro: GCD/LCM, combinatorics, primality, base conversion and 32-bit bitwise operations.

library.variablesHint: Type an assignment such as r = 5 and press = to create a variable. Then use it in any expression: π r^2.

help.equals: Calculate (repeats the last operation when empty)
help.copy: Copy the result (outside the text field)
help.multiArg: Two-argument functions use ; as separator: nthRoot(27; 3), logBase(64; 2), gcd(360; 48), nCr(10; 3).
help.variables: Variables: type r = 5 and press =, then use π r^2. Physical constants: c, h, hbar, G, NA, kB, R, qe, me, mp, eps0, mu0, sigma, atm, g0.
